description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 16.01.2017 to 22.01.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content involves regulatory matters and statutory instruments, specifically falling under the category of legal/regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for customs operations.
